_comment: Reference scores for weekly_check.py drift alarms — update when a deliberate change moves them (2026-10-20, params v1-4c0cc586: per-account replay of the displayed value, #300/#303). Each window is judged by its headline error (headline_key): the median on 5h, the mean on 7d, whose median is 0.0 for every model. The 7d window states no band per account yet (#306), so it has no coverage baseline.
